claims.text: Setting the environment variable PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN on the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud API service enables Terraform and OpenTofu to use self-hosted Pulumi Cloud as a state backend.
PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN specifies the domain that serves the Terraform-compatible API of self-hosted Pulumi Cloud (e.g. `tf.pulumiapi.acmecorp.com`).
When PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN is unset in self-hosted Pulumi Cloud, the Terraform-compatible API is disabled and its routes are not registered.
For self-hosted Pulumi Cloud, the DNS record for the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN domain should point at the same host that serves PULUMI_API_DOMAIN.
PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN may be set to the same value as PULUMI_API_DOMAIN in self-hosted Pulumi Cloud; a separate domain is not required.

The Terraform state backend guide at /docs/integrations/terraform/state-backend/ uses `tf.pulumi.com` as the domain in the terraform login/tofu login commands, TF_TOKEN_* variable name, and Terraform configuration.
A page exists at /docs/integrations/terraform/state-backend/ describing the Terraform state backend guide.
